tools.name: check_state
tools.description: Says whether Sunflower Clinic prescribes medication to residents of a US state, and lists the states it serves. Pass only the two-letter state code. Never pass a name, birthday or health details.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns what treatment costs: the one-time $20 online assessment and, if a provider prescribes, each plan's price. Naltrexone has a quarterly and an annual plan; varenicline has a quarterly plan.

tools.name: get_medication_info
tools.description: Returns Sunflower Clinic’s published answers about a medication: what it treats, evidence, side effects, safety warnings and how billing works. Quote these answers rather than paraphrasing medical claims. They are general information, not medical advice for a specific person.

tools.name: get_start_link
tools.description: Returns the link where the patient starts their own online assessment, and the steps they must do themselves. Give the link to the patient. Do not fill in the assessment for them. If you pass a state the clinic doesn’t serve, you get the list of states it does serve instead of a link.
